title: Survey on Perceptions of Discriminatory Hiring and Other HR Practices to Include Employee Respondents
what_it_is: Survey on Perceptions of Discriminatory Hiring and Other HR Practices to Include Employee Respondents

sections.label: MOM 2018 fair employment survey
sections.summary: A 2018 MOM survey found over 80% of jobseekers saw no impediment, and most employees felt fairly treated.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: In a 2018 survey commissioned by the Ministry of Manpower (MOM), over 80% of jobseekers did not feel that their gender, marital status, number of children, race, religion or nationality was an impediment in finding work.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The majority of employees also felt that they were fairly treated in their organisation in terms of their employment terms and benefits, training, career development and performance evaluation.

sections.label: Complaints, employment rates, pay gap
sections.summary: Complaints fell from about 580 in 2015 to about 200 in 2018, older and female employment rates rose, and the adjusted gender pay gap narrowed.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: A good indicator is the number of complaints, which decreased from about 580 in 2015 to about 200 in 2018 and constitutes less than 1% of all complaints received.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The employment rate of older residents aged 55 to 64 increased from 57% in 2009 to 68% in 2019, and that of female residents aged 25 to 64 increased from 64% to 73% over the same period.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: We have also seen that the adjusted gender pay gap has also narrowed over time, down from 8.8% in 2002 to 6.3% in 2018.

sections.label: Survey ground-sensing and coverage
sections.summary: The 2018 survey covered approximately 3,100 individuals and 3,400 establishments, done regularly for ground-sensing.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: So, we do this regularly, just to get ground-sensing.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: And the 2018 survey cover approximately 3,100 individuals and 3,400 establishments.

sections.label: Publishing fair employment paper
sections.summary: An occasional paper on fair employment will be published in the later part of this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: For actual details, the Member may want to file a separate Parliamentary Question because this was really just about whether we have a survey or not.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zaqy Mohamad
sentences.text: But just to answer the Member's question on whether this will be made public, we will publish an occasional paper on fair employment in the later part of this year.
